findings.explanation: Payment is due 90 days after invoicing, which creates a significant delay in receiving your funds.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to request a slight adjustment before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause ("Invoices are payable Net 90."), payment is due 90 days after invoicing, which creates a significant delay in receiving funds, so I propose modifying this to: Invoices are payable Net 30. Thank you for your time and understanding. Best regards,
